agc_driver_graphics address Stops on its check that guest heap memory lies below 1 << 40 (libSceAgcDriver/tests/Graphics.cpp, 'guest heap memory is beyond the 40-bit PS4 GPU address space'), because the ASan build maps the guest arena above 1 TiB; tracked in #16813.
agc_driver_graphics_maps_fallback address Stops on its check that guest heap memory lies below 1 << 40 (libSceAgcDriver/tests/Graphics.cpp, 'guest heap memory is beyond the 40-bit PS4 GPU address space'), because the ASan build maps the guest arena above 1 TiB; tracked in #16813.
agc_graphics_profile_draw address Stops on its check that guest heap memory lies below 1 << 40 (libSceAgcDriver/tests/Graphics.cpp, 'guest heap memory is beyond the 40-bit PS4 GPU address space'), because the ASan build maps the guest arena above 1 TiB; tracked in #16813.
guest_gpu_fault thread ThreadSanitizer runs the SIGSEGV handler of the test through its own wrapper, so the check that the handler keeps SIGUSR1 unblocked fails (libc/tests/GuestGpuFault.cpp, RequireAsyncSignalsHeld, 'gpu fault check failed at line 259'); the guest fault path cannot be checked under TSan.
guest_host_write_filter address Fails its check that the mapper signal is delivered once while the page is watched (libc/tests/GuestHostWriteFilter.cpp, RequireMapperSignals, 'host write filter check failed at line 161') in the ASan build, which moves the guest arena out of ASan's shadow gap; the cause of this check is not isolated.
kyty_shim_fault_replay thread Stops with SIGSEGV on its first deliberate guest page fault (KytyShim/tests/FaultReplay.cpp:204) under ThreadSanitizer, which does not run the fault handler of the test.
kyty_shim_memory address Stops on its check that the second view of guest memory is readable (KytyShim/src/MemoryTests.cpp:62, 'KytyShim memory check failed'), because the ASan build maps the guest arena at 0x5edb64400000 with a range of 0x10fc00000000 bytes.
kyty_shim_memory_plain_reads address Stops on the same check as kyty_shim_memory (KytyShim/src/MemoryTests.cpp:62) for the same reason: the ASan build moves the guest arena.
kyty_shim_memory thread Fails about one run in four under ThreadSanitizer (2 of 8 runs) with 'KytyShim memory: raise N parked a guest thread inside scePthreadGetprio that held the thread registry lock; another thread waited for it until the handler returned' (KytyShim/src/MemoryTests.cpp); the same test passes every time in the normal build.
kyty_shim_memory_plain_reads thread Fails intermittently under ThreadSanitizer for the same reason as kyty_shim_memory; the same test passes every time in the normal build.
kyty_shim_generic_compute_variants address Stops with SIGSEGV in its own Materialize helper (KytyShim/tests/GenericComputeVariants.cpp:121, std::fill_n on the test's fixed guest buffer at 0xc00f8000), because the ASan build reserves that low range for its shadow memory; the same test passes in the normal build.
kyty_shim_generic_compute_variants_off address Stops at the same line as kyty_shim_generic_compute_variants (GenericComputeVariants.cpp:121) for the same reason: the test's fixed guest buffer lies in a range the ASan build reserves.
kyty_shim_cross_queue_label_order address Stops with SIGSEGV inside lavapipe (libvulkan_lvp.so, on a driver worker thread) under ASan, before any Kyty frame is on the stack; the same test passes in the normal build.
kyty_shim_buffer_write_coverage address Stops on the buffer cache's guest range check ('BufferCache: invalid buffer discovery request', FindBuffer in bufferCache.cpp) for the storage buffer it maps with sceKernelMapFlexibleMemory, because the ASan build moves the guest arena outside the range Kyty accepts as guest memory; the same test passes in the normal build.
